topography.project_purpose: Yield Aggregator. Structurally: 48 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 7 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, idoconstants). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
